note: Schools whose CDS (C10) class rank can't be read as the usual cumulative shares (top 10% inside top 25% inside top 50%). The school page draws these bands as given, for that CDS year only. Davidson, Grinnell and JMU reported separate bands; Davidson's 'top half' cell says 100 but its other bands already total 100%, so that cell is ignored. Arkansas reported cumulative shares but its 'top half' cell says 14.6%; bottom half is 15.0% and its 2024-25 CDS had top half at 86%, so top half is taken as 85.0%.
